message.content:
Yes—you can file a noise complaint in Atlanta. In most cases the complaint is handled by the **City of Atlanta Police Department** or the city’s **Code Enforcement** office, rather than a “local council” (Atlanta doesn’t have a separate municipal council for noise issues). Here’s how you can do it:

| Step | What to Do | Where / How |
|------|------------|-------------|
| 1 | **Gather details** | Note the address, time, date, and description of the noise. If possible, record a short audio clip (just to help illustrate the problem). |
| 2 | **Check the city’s website** | Visit the official City of Atlanta website: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/>. Look for the “Noise Complaint” or “Code Enforcement” section. |
| 3 | **File online** | Many cities now allow online filing. On Atlanta’s site, you’ll find a “Report a Problem” or “Submit a Complaint” link. Choose “Noise” or “Code Violation” and fill out the form. |
| 4 | **Call the Police** | If you’re in immediate distress or the noise is ongoing, call 911. For non‑emergency complaints, dial the Atlanta Police Department’s non‑emergency line: **404‑656‑4000**. |
| 5 | **Visit the Police Station** | If you prefer in‑person, go to the nearest police station (e.g., the Midtown Police Station at 2000 Peachtree St NW) and speak with an officer. |
| 6 | **Follow up** | After filing, you’ll receive a reference number. Keep it handy for follow‑up. The police or code enforcement will investigate and may issue a warning or citation. |

### Quick Links

- **City of Atlanta “Report a Problem” portal**: <https://www.atlantaga.gov/portal/Report-a-Problem>
- **Atlanta Police Department – Non‑Emergency Line**: 404‑656‑4000
- **Atlanta Police Department – Midtown Station**: 2000 Peachtree St NW, Atlanta, GA 30309

### Tips

- **Timing matters**: Noise ordinances often specify quiet hours (e.g., 10 p.m.–7 a.m.). Make sure your complaint falls within those times.
- **Document everything**: Photos, videos, or audio recordings can strengthen your case.
- **Be polite but firm**: When speaking with officers, calmly explain the situation and provide your reference number.

If you’re unsure whether your issue is a noise violation or something else (like a building code violation), the police can direct you to the appropriate department. Good luck!
